Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 9
IT and Data Security
Company laptops, accounts and data must be used safely and only for work.
Passwords
Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not be reused from other websites.
Multi-factor authentication is required for email, the HR portal and the code repositories.
Laptops
Lock your laptop whenever you leave it. Do not install software that IT has not approved.
Report a lost or stolen laptop to the IT helpdesk within 2 hours.
Customer data
Customer data may only be stored in approved company systems. Never copy customer data
to personal devices, personal email or USB drives.
Security incidents
If you think you clicked a phishing link or see unusual activity, contact the IT helpdesk at once.
Reporting quickly is more important than being sure.
